method.method_draft: View the image as decomposed into elementary regions. The vertical and horizontal midpoint segments split the square into four smaller squares, and in each small square the visible diagonal from the outer corner to the center divides it into 2 elementary triangles, so there are 8 smallest triangles. Next count larger triangles formed by combining elementary triangles along drawn internal segments: along each side of the large square, the two adjacent small triangles combine into one triangle whose third vertex is the center, giving 4 such triangles. Finally, each full diagonal of the square divides the large square into 2 half-square triangles, so the two diagonals give 4 largest triangles. Sum 8 + 4 + 4 = 16.
